lm_head.source: lm_head_dtype (from_pretrained kwarg, default bfloat8_b); lm_head_fidelity (from_pretrained kwarg, NEW this stage -- fidelity was hardcoded before, see README 'Plumbing added')
lm_head.swept_this_stage: dtype axis (C01/C02: bf4 regresses top-1 -0.06 abs for a +1.36% decode gain -- rejected, see README) and fidelity axis at the shipped dtype (C03: LoFi regresses top-1 -0.02 for a noise-level +0.14% decode change -- rejected). HiFi2 kept.

norms_activations_residual.swept_this_stage: not swept -- see README 'Scoped out of this sweep': this is an architecture-wide convention set at the functional-decoder stage, not a per-tensor-group dtype knob; changing it touches every op's input/output contract and is outside a single sweep stage's safe scope

layer_exceptions.layer_0_dense: dense MLP uses dense_mlp_dtype (bfloat8_b), not the MoE-layer mlp_gateup/down bfloat4_b path. This is GLM-4.7-Flash's only architectural first/last-layer-style exception (layer 0 is the model's one dense layer, not a MoE layer) -- not a choice this sweep made or needed to make.
layer_exceptions.moe_layers_1_46: uniform policy, no per-layer exception. doc/probe/README.md's per-expert PCC under bf4 is tightly clustered (0.980913-0.981341 across all 64 experts of the probed layer): the skill's general 'exclude first/last layer' heuristic does not apply here because the quantization error this model actually shows is uniform, not layer-position-dependent, and a uniform-bf4 policy is also the documented DeepSeek/Kimi-Galaxy convention this checkpoint's own probe cites.

activation_residual_dtype: bfloat16 throughout (embedding table, decoder residual stream in L1, MoE glue). Not a sweep candidate this stage -- see 'Scoped out' in README.
ccl_dtype: N/A: single Blackhole p150 chip is the deployment target (goal explicitly puts multichip parallelism out of scope), so there are no collective/CCL ops in the measured path.

kv_cache_dtype.context_contract_impact: none -- selected dtype is unchanged from the optimized-decoder/full-model stages, so doc/context_contract.json's existing 202752-token capacity/budget figures for bf8 (and the bf16 alternative's 10.9 GiB projection) still apply unmodified. See this stage's context_contract.json 'datatype_sweep' provenance block.

logits_sampling_dtype.swept_this_stage: no lower-precision sampling dtype candidate exists in the codebase to sweep; recorded here for completeness per the skill's required-fields list

plumbing_added_this_stage: tt/model.py: GLM47FlashModel.from_pretrained gained lm_head_fidelity: str = "hifi2" (previously hardcoded MathFidelity.HiFi2); ck_lm_head is now built from FIDELITY[lm_head_fidelity]. Model instance also now exposes expert_dtype/weight_dtype/embed_dtype/lm_head_dtype/lm_head_fidelity/decoder_cls_name for the propagation check.

tt/optimized_decoder.py: OptimizedDecoder gained router_fidelity = "hifi4_fp32" class attribute (previously the router matmul's compute-kernel-config was hardcoded via the inherited ck_hifi4, which stays bound to true HiFi4+fp32acc for any other inherited functional-stage codepath that still reads it). from_state_dict now builds self.ck_router = _ck(dev, *FIDELITY[cls.router_fidelity]) and _router_scores_decode consumes self.ck_router instead of self.ck_hifi4.
proof_of_consumption: doc/datatype_sweep/runs/C00_baseline.json's policy_snapshot block is introspected directly from the real ttnn tensors and ttnn.init_device_compute_kernel_config objects on the constructed model/decoder layers (moe.wqkv_a_ds.dtype, moe.ck_attn.math_fidelity, moe.gate_w.dtype, moe.ck_router.math_fidelity, model.lm_head_weight.dtype, model.ck_lm_head.math_fidelity, etc.) after a genuine build_generator(model_dir, mesh_device) call with zero overrides -- not the requested kwargs, the actually-built objects.

That snapshot matches every field in this file. tests/check_selected_precision_config.py re-derives the snapshot fresh (rebuilding nothing; it re-imports the class defaults) and asserts the match programmatically.

doc/optimized_full_model/README.md item 2 already independently re-verified (via a fresh Tracy CSV, not by re-reading old docs) that every dominant matmul in the *full model's* measured decode path carries this exact dtype/in0_block_w policy -- this stage's C00_baseline run reproduces that stage's accuracy/perf numbers bit-for-bit-equivalent (within run-to-run noise), which is additional evidence the plumbing changes did not alter the measured runtime path.
